authority: 2026-09-07 user approval: inspect relevant verification failures, then one capped frozen-model zero-docking audit
scope: one conditional option cost/support audit, not a Q(M) comparison, discovery panel, training run, or T4 promotion
source_role: inspected PARP1 seed0 development source; no winner molecule or docking score used
region_selection: smallest region by (size, sorted atom slots, boundary) from unchanged enumerate_regions with a necessary eligible_fusion_edges witness; freeze before learned-law inspection
option_prior_policy: unchanged purpose-balanced prior with exploration; fixed option diagnostic does not draw Q(o)
executor_meter_scope: all public RewriteSystem.apply calls, including within production marked-law enumeration; model initialization separately timed

compute.expected_wall_time: unmeasured for fused five-row path; prior different 28-row profile took 420.61s; 900s is a stop limit, not an ETA

restart_unit: completed exact-state raw law and augmented reference row; persist sampled path plus RNG after every edit; no automatic retry or unvalidated cross-run reuse

acceptance.identities: verify exact image, contract self-hash, source manifest, run paths, checkpoint; existing frozen _runtime gates must pass unchanged
acceptance.support: unchanged production marked-law evaluator, stateful fused option, inherited 300/20 cap, and executor; explicit empty support, not chemical unreachability
acceptance.budgets: at most 2000 total public executor calls; 900s function timeout is incomplete work, not a matched-budget result
acceptance.validity: every sampled state complete, connected, supported and context-preserving; independent exact-slot fused-cycle witness on completion
acceptance.reporting: raw law and product funnels, selected edge, primitive path, intended release vs realized structural displacement, topology deltas, canonical candidate diversity, model/proposal/persistence time
acceptance.comparison: one attempt cannot estimate population completion rate, guide superiority, or docking gain
acceptance.promotion: no automatic guidance comparison, T4 enablement, docking, or training
